notes: TL-FC311A-20 is a single-strand (WDM) Gigabit Ethernet-to-fiber media converter, not an AV-specific device — closest listed category/type is network/Encoder-Decoder since no "Media converter" type exists in the allowed list. It is an "A" unit of a WDM pair (mates with a TL-FC311B-20 at the far end); TX/RX wavelengths are reversed on the B unit. The fiber port is physically an SC connector (single-mode, 9/125um, bidirectional over one fiber, 20km max) — mapped to "fiber-lc" only because SC is not among the allowed connector ids; treat as SC in practice. RJ45 port is 10/100/1000Mbps auto-negotiating with Auto-MDI/MDIX, graded eth-1g. Power is via an included external adapter (5V/0.6A); TP-Link's spec page does not state the DC barrel plug dimensions, so dc-barrel is inferred (standard for this device class) rather than confirmed. Desktop unit, not rack-mountable on its own (optional TL-FC1420 rack-mount tray available for multiple units), so rackUnits omitted.
